subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a folder-backed encrypted snapshot and workspace-mirroring backup workflow with new `backup.*` config, or should the core backup surface stay limited to local archive create/verify for now?
rationale: The PR adds new user-facing CLI, persisted config, secret-backed encryption settings, and destructive restore behavior, so correctness fixes alone do not settle whether this is the intended core product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor after repairs
options.body: Keep this PR open for maintainer-sponsored product/security review after it is rebased, proven in a real setup, and the security findings are fixed.

options.title: Narrow the core scope
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that improves the existing archive create/verify flow while deferring snapshot storage and workspace mirroring to a later design.

options.title: Pause or close direction
options.body: Decline built-in folder-backed snapshots for now and keep broader backup strategy discussion on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open for maintainer-sponsored product/security review after it is rebased, proven in a real setup, and the security findings are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup validation refactor history plus CODEOWNERS-adjacent repository ownership make this the best available routing candidate from the inspected history.
